BiblicalUsage: Baaseiah was a Levite of the house of Merari, named in the genealogy of the singers — the son of Malchiah, the father of Michael, and the ancestor of Asaph's line. He appears once, in the long song of the Levites who stood before the ark.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the singers' genealogies are kept because worship is a family business, and Baaseiah's name in Asaph's line is his share in the song.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
